_source: Cast for the first release, aligned with the client's canon (geode-inn docs: walkthrough dissections 13 Main Floor and 14 Campgrounds, Sep 10 2026; character_rename_ledger; dialogue_entries.json). Names, roles and places follow canon. Voices are instrument blips: base_hz pitch, reveal_ms per letter, pause_ms after a sentence, expressiveness 0-1. Host, Catalyst, Ragana and Owl pitches come from the client's voice profiles; the rest are first passes. Characters with no dialogue entry are present but not talked to (Charles, Ziggy, the dragon, the wolf, Pluck). Real people's details stay out of every player-facing line.

host.name: The Host
host.role: The Inn-Tree's own avatar. A gentle giant at the door, glad you came.

firekeeper.name: The Firekeeper
firekeeper.role: The storyteller of the hearth. The fire never gutters because someone chose to tend it.

catalyst.name: The Catalyst
catalyst.role: Runs the bar built into the wall beside the fire, and grows the impossible garden behind it.

ragana.name: The Ragana
ragana.role: The measurer, at the reading table in the Library Nook. The highest praise in the Inn is the Ragana's Adequate.

naut.name: Naut
naut.role: A four-foot squid-headed scholar by the Library Nook's fireplace. Fascinating.

wanderer.name: The Wanderer
wanderer.role: A warm, weathered traveler with two ravens that steal shiny things.

brindle.name: Brindle
brindle.role: A frazzled brownie, always losing something.

charles.name: Charles
charles.role: The Chameleon Druid. Found by the fire more than anywhere, blending in.

ziggy.name: Ziggy
ziggy.role: A crested gecko, always smiling, hiding somewhere from the very first hour.

dragon.name: The Baby Dragon
dragon.role: Asleep in the geode. The geode fills with gems as you grow.

jay.name: Jay
jay.role: The Huntsman. Runs the tavern, the welcome before the door. The wolf is never far.

wisteria.name: Wisteria
wisteria.role: Manages the Huntsman Tavern. The kitchen is warm.

wolf.name: The Wolf
wolf.role: Jay's wolf. Always there when Jay is, and sometimes when Jay isn't.

luna.name: Luna
luna.role: The maker at the bench in the tent-studio. The jeweler's calm.

blacksmith.name: The Blacksmith
blacksmith.role: Keeps the working fire. Has never counted the beat and has never needed to.

fortune.name: The Fortune Teller
fortune.role: Reads the stones you carry. Recognition, never prediction.

zeke.name: Zeke
zeke.role: The Pirate at the dock. The bodhran, the tide chart, the beat for the whole water system.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.role: Arrives first at every drum circle. Dances to your tempo.

vaulknut.name: Vaulknut
vaulknut.role: Master crafter of the Tidal Caves. Works alone. Only witnessed.

faire_herald.name: The Faire Herald
faire_herald.role: Welcomes visitors to whichever faire is in town.
